delete.summary:
End a session and release its sequence watermark. Reopening clients should
use a new identifier so abandoned requests cannot collide with new work.

post.summary:
Preparation never writes an edit. The caller saves chosen parameters using
the existing expected-revision edit command after reviewing this response.

x-iris-approximate.description: True when proxy evaluation was used

x-iris-gpu-fallback.description: GPU attempt fell back to CPU

x-iris-render-backend.description: cpu, gpu or mixed for this render

post.summary:
Transient slider feedback: validates source binding and resources but writes
no history. Persist the chosen document separately through SaveEdit.

RAW sensor gains, not a rendered RGB filter. Neutral sampling uses the
oriented/cropped decoded source coordinates before any edit geometry.

x-iris-full-frame-evaluation.description: True: evaluates entire image before crop

200.description: Unmodified source bytes; RAW and HEIC review uses JPEG previews

photo_ids.description: Omitted means all active project photos; an empty list means no photos.

contrast.description: Contrast exponent multiplier 2^contrast around pivot; signed power keeps negatives.

highlights.description: Smooth masked log2 gains [-2,2], with separate broad/endpoint masks.

temperature.description: Creative RGB gains in stops [-1,1]; not Kelvin or RAW illuminant correction.

mix.description: Linear RGB mix; coefficients in [-2,2], sum must be one.

BrowseContext.description: Browsing changes only queued work, never starts a job or changes its scope.

client_id.description: Stable id for one window; monotonically increasing revisions reject late requests.

points.description: Polyline in normalized image coordinates, connected by continuous capsules.

shadows.description: Per-channel log2 gains [-2,2], smoothly blended by linear Y.

Composition.description: Explainable portrait-placement geometry, not a learned aesthetic assessment.

points.description:
Empty means identity. Otherwise 2..=64 points, strictly increasing x,
nondecreasing y, all coordinates in [0,1]. Endpoints must have x=0 and x=1.

atmospheric_light.description: Scalar atmospheric light in linear RGB [0.01,16].

dehaze.description: [-1,1]: negative adds veiling light; positive removes it.

luminance_denoise.description: Blend with a joint bilateral estimate [0,1].

sharpening_threshold.description: Suppress differences smaller than this linear-light value [0,0.25].

image_data_url.description: Bounded JPEG of this original region; absent when native detail is unavailable.

state.description: full_detail, preview_only, or unavailable. No automatic reject decision.

region.description: x, y, width, height in the oriented image, normalized to 0..1.

DetectorModelStatus.description: `available` means file/hash/metadata checks passed, not inference or accuracy validation.

sha256.description: Actual SHA-256 of bytes read; null when no model bytes could be inspected.

render.description: Revision is the saved base revision, not an unsaved counter.

node_positions.description: View-only data is excluded from the rendering fingerprint.

EditRecipe.description: Portable settings only: no photo identifier, filename or source fingerprint.

sha256.description: SHA-256 verified against the pinned local artifact; absent on failure.

EyeVisibility.description: Visible-face mask measurements in a fixed eye-corner ROI, not calibrated occlusion probabilities.

analysis_key.description: Echo the current key returned by group selection; stale corrections are rejected.

face_index.description: Null explicitly means that the main person is absent in this photo.

state.description: geometry_candidate or uncertain; users must verify correspondence.

chromatic_aberration.description: Additional red/blue radial scale relative to green, bounded to +/- 0.1.

crop.description: [left, top, width, height], normalized to the input frame.

perspective.description: Row-major inverse homography in normalized image coordinates.

radial.description: Inverse radial mapping r -> r*(1+k1*r²+k2*r⁴), radius in half short edge.

vignette_stops.description: Exposure lift at radius 1 in stops (quadratic radial rolloff).

dedicated_video_memory_bytes.description: Adapter capacities, not current memory usage or free-memory budgets.

device_id.description: Pass unchanged as AnalysisSettings.directml_device_id. Never reindex a filtered list.

is_integrated.description: D3D12 UMA query; absent when this adapter cannot create a D3D12 device.

luid.description: DXGI adapter LUID, useful within the current Windows boot; not a persistent ID.

default_device_id.description: DirectML's default index 0 when it exists, not a fastest-device recommendation.

inference_verified.description: Always false: presence does not establish runtime/model compatibility or speed.

amount.description: Additive uniform noise amplitude in linear units [0,0.25].

reference_photo_id.description: Comparison reference only. Never an instruction to discard other members.

state.description: reference, manual, absent, geometry_candidate, uncertain, or stale.

bins.description: RGB and luminance, excluding fully transparent pixels.

preview_width.description:
Full-quality requests measure every output pixel; interactive requests
measure the displayed proxy. These are the actual measured dimensions.

center.description: Centre in degrees [0,360]; wrap-around is supported.

luminance.description: Additive linear luminance change [-1,1], scaled by chroma selection.

width.description: Half-width in degrees (1..180), triangular selection weight.

source_folder.description: Omitted selects the pinned public download; otherwise read this local folder.

quality_ready.description: Quality results are committed; optional semantic grouping may still be running.

chromatic_aberration.description: Additional red/blue scale relative to green, after the radial mapping.

radial.description: Inverse r -> r*(1+k1*r^2+k2*r^4), radius in half the short image edge.

vignette_stops.description: Exposure lift: 2^(stops * min(r^2,1)), evaluated at mapped input position.

calibrated_dimensions.description: Exact developed source extent; transposed dimensions permit EXIF rotation.

oneOf.description: Optical coefficients only: never replace existing geometry wholesale.

issues.description: Stable reason codes; no fuzzy matching or fallback to file names.

placement.description:
Merge optical coefficients into a node using the uncropped source extent.
This response never mutates a document or replaces crop/rotation/perspective.

oneOf.description: Omitted fields remain unchanged. Use pending, zero, or none to clear.
Elliptical falloff: full weight within hardness, zero at radii.
Linear Rec.2020 luminance; feather is in linear luminance units.
Euclidean distance in linear Rec.2020 RGB, not perceptual Delta E.

sha256.description: Actual hash of read bytes. Available only describes artifact checks, not inference or licensing.

oneOf.description: Inputs: base Image, adjusted Image, Mask. Linear-light interpolation.

parameters.description: Inputs: base Image, adjusted Image, Mask. Linear-light interpolation.

background.description: Opaque JPEG background, specified as encoded sRGB values.

gamut_compression.description: Neutral-axis gamut compression in the target's linear RGB primaries.

analysis_status.description: Cache compatibility with the engine/settings and the last scanned source metadata.

photo_id.description: Reveal a search hit without loading an entire project into the frontend.

scene_id.description: Transient scene navigation scope; other filters and pagination still apply.

oneOf.description: None means the gains cannot be expressed within the supported model.

groups_dirty.description: Group membership/ranking must be rebuilt, including after reopening a project.

pending_analysis.description: Active photos without current-engine analysis, independent of pagination.

oneOf.description: Optional unsaved adjustments, validated against the saved source and base revision.

camera_to_working.description: Maps WB-multiplied camera RGB to linear Rec.2020; D65 neutral row normalized.

oneOf.description: Interpret draft sensor gains without changing the saved edit.
Original orientation-normalized RAW pixels, before edit geometry.

RegionRequest.description:
Native 1:1 pixels in final edited-image coordinates. The entire graph is
currently evaluated before cropping; max_edge does not resize this region.

oneOf.description: Transient adjustments; source identity and saved base revision remain checked.
Supply exactly one of rect (absolute output pixels) or view (centered viewport).

RegionView.description:
A native-pixel viewport centered in the final, edited image. Normalized
coordinates avoid guessing dimensions after rotation, perspective or crop.

oneOf.description: Export-only adjustments. Snapshot them without changing the saved edit.

kind.description: scene_candidate, manual, or unsequenced; never an exact-duplicate judgment.

effective_weight.description: Normalized share of the final score, in 0..1.

contribution.description: Points inside the category, before its top-level weight.

weight.description: Actual normalized share inside this category; zero for missing terms.

kind.description: observation, limitation, or context; missing evidence is not a defect.

raw_white_balance.description: None means camera as-shot WB. Explicit gains are sensor RGB, not Kelvin.

shadows.description: Log2 gains in four overlapping bands centred at Y=0, 1/3, 2/3, 1.

oneOf.description: Appropriate for already-rendered inputs and intentionally clipped output.
Identity up to knee, then exponential shoulder approaching display white.

midpoint.description: Fraction of centre-to-corner radius at which falloff begins [0,0.99].

WhiteBalanceTemperature.description: Coordinates in Iris's illuminant model, not vendor-specific temperature/tint.
